correctness.rationale: For all integers m,n≥2 and α,β≥0, P=Z_{Kmn}+αΔ_A+βΔ_B in the fixed standard-coordinate Euclidean metric has diameter squared equal to mn(m+n)+2α²+2β² exactly when α≤m−1, β≤n−1. The complete source RESULT.md proof gives exact signed-matrix expression max_s [∑r_i²+∑c_j²+2αosc(r)+2βosc(c)]+2α²+2β² by extreme-point convexity; D_B≥2(m−1)osc(r) from mixed columns and D_A≥2(n−1)osc(c) from mixed rows establish upper bound. All-positive signs realize equality, a whole flipped row/column gives strict excess ≥4n(α−m+1) or ≥4m(β−n+1). Independent exact signed-matrix checks for m,n=(2,2),(2,3),(3,3),(3,4) and 16 weight cases reproduced inequalities and sharp region. Finite checks are corroborative only; universal proof is combinatorial.
